title: Replay recorded LLM calls
one_line: Re-run captured LLM calls and see what changed in answers, tokens and cost.
verified_against: Request shapes read from installed openai 3.57.0, anthropic 2.12.0, google-genai 3.6.1, boto3/botocore 1.44.9 (2026-11-21). Executors exercised only through each SDK's fake transport and botocore Stubber; no live provider call was made. Cassette executor and CLI run end to end on synthetic records.
